main_text.l: in 1 kal Aprili, hoc est, in 21 Martii die: & vult ne-omeniam illam quæ proxima est æquinoctio verno initium esse menfis Paschalis, qui Ægyptiis menfis nouorum, Hebrais autem Nisan appellatur. Præterea annos indictionum, vt computari a menfe Septembri: cuius respectu Aprilis habeatur pro menfe octau, quo plerunque in idar[?] neomenia Paschalis. Duplex etiam facit in tum ipsius anni, vnum politicum, quo dfumitur a Septembri, vel potius a 19 die Augusti iuxta calendarium Diocletiani: alterum ecclesiasticum, quod deducitur a neomenia Paschali.

page.notes: The Ind. column reads 3–15, then 1–7 in the second group. Doubtful readings: "idar" in the paragraph, which may be a misprint for idem, marked [?]. The Nabon. number in row 13 is printed as "1148" with a stray mark. The Maii notes are set in the middle column between the rows and are not margin notes. The table has no marginal notes.
